purpose: Fixed source-roster admission and relatedness-group split rules before biological fitting; not a complete executable model run specification
identifier_rule: Use the label audit original-source bacteria ID; require exact equality with deposited source_id. Do not promote punctuation-only candidates to stock identity. All402 current original-source IDs exactly match deposit IDs; sequence bytes remain separately authenticated.
host_exclusion_rule: Require all403 deposited host files and complete target ANI audit bindings. Seed exclusions from near/boundary/unreported/name flags and propagate to complete published core-distance components; do not retain another member of an excluded host group.

phage_grouping.all_nodes: All97 deposited representations plus2frozen target references, including nonmodel/excluded bridge nodes
phage_grouping.edge_rule: similarity >=69.99; exact complete unrounded matrix, undirected connected components
phage_grouping.exclusion_rule: Exclude target-containing components and components containing any near-gp17 exclusion seed; retain source representation caveats

label_rule: Exclude all156 original-source-empty pairs, every nonblank conflict, any unmapped input and every row involving an excluded genome/group. Record all reasons without double-counting removed pairs. No replacement labels.

group_splits.assignment: Hash seed+axis+group ID with SHA256; sort by digest then ID; assign cyclically to three folds. No label or genome-count optimization.
group_splits.outer_blocks: All3x3host/phage fold combinations; each eligible pair is test exactly once; train uses neither held-out host nor held-out phage fold; mixed quadrants are embargoed in that fold.
group_splits.insufficient_groups_or_empty_partitions: Fail explicitly; no random split fallback or automatic fold-count relaxation.
group_splits.single_class_training_or_test: Record explicitly; single-class fits must abstain and undefined binary-discrimination metrics stay undefined. Do not choose new partitions from labels.
group_splits.publication_scope: Original source collection is one experimental publication; disclose shared publication. These group folds do not constitute leave-publication-out validation.

admission_requires: Authenticated all403source-host files and actual host-audit matrix/report/executable/target/policy bindings
Authenticated deposited phage representations, full unrounded relatedness matrix and original-R validation
Consistent nonblank training labels and exact original-source-ID to deposit crosswalk
Retained/excluded row/genome/group manifests and explicit deterministic partitions
still_required_before_fit: Fold-specific train-only feature vocabularies, feature assignment and input-vector collision reports
Complete model/feature selection/weights/seed/dependency parameters frozen in actual run specification
Measured resource feasibility for full host feature construction and actual interaction modelling
